question: The stored values of Site Styles' Fonts, Buttons and Forms views, the Themes popover and the closed lists, for oracle-readback.mjs.
how: Blocks Probe, Site Styles opened by name, each view and the views one row under it read twice. Save off at every read, no question on Exit. Each entry is label, words, input value, state, swatch. The lists: a row pressed by name, the pointer moved off it, the list read and closed by Escape with nothing in it pressed; Save off after each. `families` is every name in the font list, scrolled by script. No pick, slider, pack, Reset or row change.
anchor: Stored after the probes. scripts/check-readback.mjs compares what has an older read: every button type's font, shape, outline and padding choice against CAP-BUTTONROWS; Forms and Form Spacing against CAP-FORMROWS; form fonts, the Darkest 2 form colors and which Effects tiles are on against CAP-FORMSUBS; Headings, Paragraphs and Spacing against CAP-SITESTYLEROWS; base size, Headings, Paragraphs, Spacing, Animations and the palette against CAP-ARTROWS' full print of 2026-11-05 06:57 UTC. Nothing differs. Nothing older exists for: Fonts > Buttons, Fonts > Miscellaneous, the button padding numbers (1.3em and 3.5em), the Selection Options rows, Image Blocks. Those are only as old as this list.
notRead: Weights of other fonts: the list is read for Poppins, and another font would take a pick. Ours offers 100 to 900 for every font.
Skipped, a press could write or leads to a store: the font list's Upload and manage custom fonts, typing in Search all fonts, and a pick in its language filter. The filter's list itself is stored.
Assign Styles below Site Title: the view holds every row's name and value, but only Site Title's own view and its two lists were opened.
Fonts > Buttons' second and third font rows: only the first was opened. All three read Poppins in the view.

listsAgainstOurs: scripts/check-readback.mjs: our Style, Weight and Text Transform lists, Shape and Field Shape tiles and Themes tiles and groups hold the same names as `lists`. Not built here: the font list (ours is a faded row) and Assign Styles (ours is a faded row). Those two are read only.
listsNotes: An Assign Styles row opens a view with its own lists (Site Title: Style Heading, Size Custom). A closed list's selected option comes from aria-selected. Escape with nothing open closes Site Styles, which writes nothing: read in the probe, Save off, no question. The filter opens on Latin, not All Fonts. Fonts > Buttons and Fonts > Miscellaneous are unbuilt rows in ours, so those lists are read only; the form fonts' Style and Size are checked by scripts/check-readback.mjs against ours if ours offers them.
